title: Jesus... Why Should I Forgive Them?

bible.text: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Up to seven times?" Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times."

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why should I forgive someone who hurt me so deeply? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: They knew exactly what they were doing. I trusted them, and they broke that trust.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know the pain of being betrayed. Forgiveness doesn't mean pretending that what happened was okay.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then what does forgiveness even mean? Because I'm still angry.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It means choosing not to let what they did keep controlling your heart.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if they never say sorry?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You cannot control whether they repent. But you can choose whether bitterness gets to live inside you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So forgiving them doesn't mean I have to trust them again?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. Forgiveness and trust are not the same. You can forgive someone while still keeping wise boundaries. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Forgiveness is not saying the wound never happened. It is choosing not to let the wound become your whole story.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Is there someone you're struggling to forgive? 🙏 You don't have to carry that pain alone.
